configuration.comparison: same frozen O3 CI library and probe; only candidate calls enable_builder_payback_reserve

primary: paired mean total production at turn 75, separately for Emperor and Deity; early endings/deaths counted as zero
secondary: production / strongest stock rival production at75
pilot_gate: positive mean production lift at75 in both difficulties, no lower survival, science >=90% baseline at75; otherwise leave confirmation unplayed
confirmation_gate: at least5% mean production lift at75 in both difficulties, no lower survival, science >=90% baseline; report paired bootstrap intervals and sample limitations
stopping: no seed exclusion, no rerun to replace a loss, no tuning on confirmation; failed pilot consumes its seeds for diagnostics only
